tagline: Gardens you love, all year round
intro: Friendly, reliable garden design and maintenance across Bristol and the surrounding villages.
about:
Green Leaf started with one van, one mower and a love of tidy borders. Twelve years later we look after more than two hundred gardens across Bristol, from small terraced courtyards to large family lawns.

We turn up when we say we will, leave every garden tidier than we found it, and give honest advice about what will actually thrive in your space.

values.title: We turn up
values.text: Booked visits happen on the day we agree, every time.

values.title: Honest advice
values.text: We'll tell you what will really grow, not what costs the most.

values.title: Tidy finish
values.text: Every clipping is cleared and taken away before we leave.

projects.title: Cottage border
projects.summary: A tired lawn edge turned into a deep, colourful cottage border that flowers from April to October.
projects.details: We lifted the old turf, improved the soil with compost, and planted foxgloves, salvias, roses and grasses in loose drifts.

projects.title: New lawn
projects.summary: A patchy, mossy lawn replaced with fresh turf and a simple care plan.
projects.details: Full strip, levelled and re-turfed in two days, followed by a monthly feeding programme.

projects.title: Courtyard makeover
projects.summary: A dark, paved yard became a green outdoor room with raised beds and climbers.
projects.details: Oak raised beds, shade-loving ferns and hostas, and jasmine on new trellis to soften the walls.

projects.title: Hedge restoration
projects.summary: An overgrown laurel hedge brought back to a neat, healthy shape.
projects.details: Staged reduction over two visits to keep the hedge healthy, with all waste removed.

projects.title: Wildflower meadow
projects.summary: Part of a large lawn sown as a wildflower meadow for bees and butterflies.
projects.details: Ground prepared and sown with a native mix, with a mown path through the middle.

projects.title: Spring clear-up
projects.summary: A full spring clear-up to get a neglected garden ready for the season.
projects.details: Beds weeded and mulched, shrubs pruned, and lawn scarified and fed.
